test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 30 Aug 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Two train engines of same length are running in the same direction with speeds of 18 km/h and 36 km/h. If the faster engine crosses the slower one in 8 sec, what is the length of each train engine?
solution:
**Given:**

Speed of slower engine (S₁) = 18 km/h

Speed of faster engine (S₂) = 36 km/h

Time (t) = 8 sec

**Formula used:**

Relative Speed = S₂ - S₁

Distance = Relative Speed × Time

Length of each train engine = Distance / 2

**Calculation:**

Relative Speed = 36 km/h - 18 km/h

⇒ Relative Speed = 18 km/h

Convert Relative Speed to m/s: 18 km/h = 18 × (1000/3600) m/s

⇒ Relative Speed = 5 m/s

Distance = Relative Speed × Time

⇒ Distance = 5 m/s × 8 s

⇒ Distance = 40 m

Length of each train engine = Distance / 2

⇒ Length of each train engine = 40 m / 2

⇒ Length of each train engine = 20 m

**∴ The correct answer is option (1).**
